unit: independent addressed world root, with shared random addresses within each paired block
analysis: one-sided paired-root t tests versus zero with two-sided 95% intervals, Holm family A1/D1. No test for failed verification, insufficient independent roots, zero variance, or technical/mechanism failure. Precision and test decision reported separately.

A1.hypothesis: Selective exposure increases the effect of herding on actual post-shock maximum drawdown
A1.metric: drawdown from real trading closes, starting at last pre-shock close
A1.missing: no close is undefined; unfunded boundary retained outside the primary family

D1.hypothesis: Cumulative trust and selective network exchange interact positively on eligible late cooperation
D1.metric: cooperative choices per offered late seat in matched shared risk sets
D1.missing: natural pre-offer stops stay allocated, are absent from the eligible estimand, and contribute zero to assigned-seat cooperation. Retain at-risk no-offers and failures separately.

strategy.scope: one directed eligible seat replaces rule application with the fixed synthetic archived wait; paired signed difference in actual wages from the registered new contract
strategy.analysis: descriptive, outside primary tests; all-source follow-up wages separate
